usa: PITI groups principal, interest, property tax and homeowners insurance. Mortgage insurance and association dues are additional categories. The result is only complete for the costs explicitly entered; maintenance, utilities and closing cash need their own budget.

Private mortgage insurance is distinct from homeowners insurance. Whether it is required and what it costs depend on the loan and insurer. Enter the lender's actual premium rather than a generic percentage. This calculator does not obtain an insurance quote or promise cancellation after a future valuation.

Minimum cash down depends on the program, property and borrower eligibility. Conventional, FHA, VA and USDA products have different requirements and costs. Use the appropriate program tool and confirm the actual lender and agency conditions; a small deposit does not remove closing cash or guarantee approval.

PMI cancellation and automatic termination have different conditions. Original value, the scheduled balance, payment history and applicable rules matter; appreciation alone does not automatically remove a charge. Read CFPB's official cancellation explanation and ask the servicer to identify the process for the actual mortgage.

DTI compares counted monthly debt with qualifying income. Housing-only and total-debt ratios include different obligations. The income definition, counted payment and permitted ratio depend on the lender and program. A planning ratio is neither a universal approval cap nor proof that the household can afford its ordinary living costs.

A fixed-rate scenario holds the entered rate constant. An ARM can change under its index, margin, reset timing and contractual caps. Use the ARM tool for explicit reset assumptions. Neither the initial payment nor a central-bank benchmark predicts what a future adjustment will be.
canada: Mortgage default insurance protects the lender and is separate from property insurance. A purchase may require an insurer-approved premium depending on the loan and deposit. The supported CMHC calculation has a stated product scope; it does not establish approval, and other insurers or special products can differ. Check CMHC's published premium and purchase requirements.

A qualifying payment tests an assessment scenario and need not equal the contractual debit. OSFI's uninsured framework, insurer rules and lender policies have different scope and exceptions. Use the standard qualifying-rate tool with the applicable framework, then include counted housing costs, debts and documented income. Do not treat one ratio as an automatic pass.

The minimum down payment is graduated for eligible insured purchases and changes with the purchase-price category. Check the official FCAC/CMHC requirements for the transaction, including the insured-purchase ceiling. The model does not verify the source of funds or replace the separate cash needed for closing and premium tax.

Longer insured amortization depends on the applicable first-time-buyer or new-build criteria and lender/insurer acceptance. It is not automatically available to every purchaser. Uninsured products have their own terms. Confirm eligibility before selecting a longer insured scenario; the relevant premium surcharge and higher lifetime interest also matter.

The Home Buyers' Plan is a CRA program for eligible RRSP withdrawals with participation and repayment conditions. Do not treat an account balance as an automatically available withdrawal, or assume every withdrawal is permanently tax-free. Use the current CRA guidance and provider-confirmed amount, and keep FHSA and RRSP funds from being counted twice.

A fixed-rate agreement and a variable-rate agreement can have different accrual, payment-adjustment and break-cost terms. Use the stated nominal compounding convention and the actual quote. A Bank of Canada policy observation is monetary-policy context, not a personal mortgage offer or a prediction of the next renewal payment.
uk: SDLT applies to relevant transactions in England and Northern Ireland. Scotland uses LBTT and Wales uses LTT. The jurisdiction, transaction date, property type and buyer category determine treatment; use the appropriate dedicated tool and confirm the actual case with the conveyancer rather than applying one UK-wide percentage.

First-time-buyer relief requires every relevant purchaser and transaction to meet the conditions. A checkbox models an assumed category; it does not prove entitlement. Price ceilings, additional-property treatment and residence rules can affect the result. Check HMRC's dated guidance for England and Northern Ireland and the separate national rules elsewhere.

LTV divides the mortgage principal by the relevant assessed property value. It is a descriptive ratio, not a complete underwriting decision. A changed valuation or financed fee can change it. The lender decides the valuation and product conditions; this site does not infer a rate discount from a chosen LTV band.

Interest-only payments do not reduce principal in the illustrated phase. The debt must still be settled, and a later repayment payment can be larger when fewer years remain. Check the lender's repayment-plan requirements and use the transition tool instead of treating the lower opening debit as full repayment.

The fixed deal period and the total repayment term can be different. A tracker follows the contract's named benchmark and margin; it does not necessarily equal the policy rate alone. Compare the actual reset and follow-on terms. No future offer or fixed-period extension is predicted here.

Remortgage comparisons should include the same comparison horizon, remaining balances, known fees, cashback obligations and early repayment charges. Extending the term can reduce the monthly payment while increasing interest. The dedicated quote comparison separates cash-flow savings from the cost of debt over that horizon.
australia: LMI protects the lender and is separate from homeowners insurance. Whether it is required, its price and whether it can be financed depend on the product, lender, insurer and any confirmed scheme. Use an actual all-in quote. This site does not generate an insurer tariff solely from a deposit percentage.

An offset can reduce the balance used for interest under the product's terms while the contractual principal remains outstanding. Its benefit depends on the offset percentage, actual cash path, fees and interest convention. Money in an offset is not automatically principal repaid; use the offset tool instead of counting the same funds as both a larger deposit and an offset balance.

Compare regular repayment frequency with accelerated repayment separately. The annual amount paid, not only the size of one debit, determines the effect on debt. Confirm the lender's convention and any limits or costs on additional payments before treating an accelerated schedule as available.

Purchase duty and concessions depend on the state or territory, transaction date, value, property and buyer category. No single national duty range or first-home exemption is assumed. Use the supported general-rate tool and the relevant revenue authority, and enter a confirmed assessment for concessions or special cases.

Government deposit-support schemes have current eligibility and property rules that must be confirmed with the program and participating lender. A calculator cannot award a guarantee or determine that LMI is waived. Count only confirmed assistance and preserve a separate closing-cost reserve.

A serviceability assessment and a monthly repayment are different calculations. Lenders consider income, living costs, other debts and their applicable assessment policy. The RBA policy rate is not your mortgage quote. Use the actual quoted rate and a separately labelled assessment scenario without treating the result as approval.
newzealand: RBNZ LVR settings restrict portions of bank lending in defined categories. They are not unconditional deposit requirements or personal approval entitlements for every borrower. The lender must still assess income, expenses, the property and its available product. Use actual valuation and principal in an LVR scenario.

A first-home KiwiSaver withdrawal requires provider-confirmed eligibility and an eligible balance, with required retention. Membership duration alone does not prove all conditions. Use the withdrawal tool and current IRD/provider guidance, and do not count an expected withdrawal and the same savings balance twice.

A low-equity premium or margin is a product-specific quote. Enter the actual rate addition, cash fee and duration rather than a typical range. A lower LVR does not automatically remove the charge: check the contract and ask whether a lender reassessment or product change is required.

Do not add a hoped-for grant or assistance amount to a deposit. Program availability and first-home eligibility need confirmation with the provider. The funding tool combines only confirmed savings, withdrawal and support amounts; it does not revive a closed grant or announce a new award.

The mortgage term and a fixed-rate period can be different. When a fixed period ends, a new quote can change the payment or remaining term. The constant-rate illustration is not a forecast of the next refix. Use the split/refix tool for actual loan portions and clearly stated quote scenarios.

Rental ownership budgets need operating expenses, occupancy, financing and applicable tax treatment kept separate. Gross yield does not equal spendable profit. Confirm legal and tax obligations for the actual property, and use an adviser-confirmed amount where a calculator does not model the particular case.
india: The EMI model uses financed principal and a reducing-balance nominal rate over monthly periods. A flat-rate advertisement is not the same input. Use the rate convention and all-in processing charges in the lender's disclosure; no universal processing-fee percentage is assigned to every provider.

Home-loan tax treatment depends on the applicable tax year, law, chosen regime, property use and confirmed qualifying amounts. Familiar legacy section labels do not establish a current deduction. Prepare the relevant taxable income and deduction with current official guidance or an adviser; the EMI itself is not a tax-benefit calculation.

FOIR compares the counted obligations with the income definition used in the assessment. It is not one fixed approval percentage for every bank. Enter a lender-confirmed target or a clearly labelled planning assumption, and retain ordinary living costs in the household cash budget.

Prepayment charges and borrower rights depend on the applicable current directions, product, rate type, purpose and agreement. Confirm the actual permitted repayment and all-in charge before modeling an extra payment or balance transfer. This website does not promise that every loan can be closed without cost.

A joint application combines accepted income and counted obligations under the lender's rules. Adding a co-applicant does not automatically improve the offered rate, establish legal ownership or create an individual tax deduction. Confirm the actual ownership, repayment responsibility and relevant tax treatment separately.

Loan documents depend on the lender, borrower category, property and transaction. Ask for the provider's current checklist. Do not send identity documents, bank statements or application records to this website; the calculators only need the financial figures required for the stated scenario.
europe: Mortgage quotes and legal requirements differ by country and lender. This page uses EUR amounts and entered assumptions, not a single Europe-wide product. Compare the actual disclosure and check the local transaction rules. The currency alone does not establish rate, deposit or tax treatment.

Notary, registration, legal and property-tax charges are different items. There is no verified Europe-wide percentage or general ban on financing all such costs here. Obtain the relevant local assessment and itemized quotes, then enter the agreed financed or cash amounts once.

Non-resident mortgage availability and conditions are provider- and transaction-specific. No universal rate uplift, deposit percentage or approval rule is inferred. Use an actual quote and a confirmed LTV/cash requirement in the non-resident budget; it does not determine residency or tax status.

A deposit target is an entered budget assumption. Valuation, product eligibility, local rules and the lender determine actual borrowing. Closing costs and reserves can require additional cash. Do not treat an advertised maximum LTV in one country as available to every borrower elsewhere.

A variable-rate contract can specify an index tenor, fixing date, margin, reset schedule and floor. Euribor is not the ECB MRO or deposit-facility rate. Enter the contractual fixing plus actual margin in the dedicated tool; no universal spread or reset frequency is assumed.

Early repayment rights and charges depend on national law, the contract and the particular transaction. Request the lender's actual settlement quotation and relevant local guidance before comparing a refinance. No single German, French or Europe-wide penalty cap is asserted by this basic payment page.
